job.name: bot_avatar_monogram
job.prompt: Square avatar for a Telegram bot of «ИИаватар» — an AI video production service (text turns into video with a digital presenter). Design system of the website: deep black background #0E0E0E, white bold geometric grotesque type, one acid lime-yellow accent #D7F23C. Composition strictly centred, everything important inside the central 70% (the image will be cropped to a circle). A bold white monogram «ИИ» (two Cyrillic letters И, perfectly spelled, heavy grotesque, tight spacing) with a small solid lime-yellow play-triangle integrated next to or inside the letters. Flat vector, crisp, minimal, premium, high contrast, readable at 64 px. No other text, no gradients-noise, no mockup frame, no shadows around the canvas.
job.meaning: аватарка бота ИИаватар: белая монограмма «ИИ» и лаймовый треугольник «play» на чёрном фоне, по центру
